title: Initial Development and Evaluation of the Creative Artificial Intelligence through Recurring Developments and Determinations (CAIRDD) System
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and benchmarking the creativity of LLM-generated content using rubrics defined by creative and literary metrics (such as novelty, world-building, and craftsmanship). While the generated story concepts in the appendix often involve moral themes or ethical dilemmas (e.g., corporate control, rebellion, and personal moral compasses), these are narrative elements of the creative output being tested, not components of a methodology to benchmark or evaluate the religious, moral, or ethical alignment of the models themselves.
